docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The first part of Rhys Davids’ translation of the Milindapañha, with his introduction on the date and the history of the book (Oxford, 1890). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Princeton Theological Seminary Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The questions of King Milinda · Davids, T. W. Rhys (Thomas William Rhys), 1843-1922, ed. and tr · 1890-94, 442 scanned pages. Published 1890; T. W. Rhys Davids died 1922; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
